local_review.finding_body: Two SFTP outbound-gateway assertions used QueueChannel.receive() without a timeout, so a missing reply could wait indefinitely in violation of §FS-test-contract.1.6.
local_review.finding_title: Unbounded asynchronous reply waits in generated tests
local_review.fix_note: Changed both QueueChannel waits to receive(10_000L), preserving the assertions while bounding each wait at the contract's 10-second minimum, then ran the required Forge finalization command successfully.
local_review.review_comment: Verified the single-coordinate diff, allowed Docker image declaration and successful scan, index and metadata format/scope, meaningful public-API tests, separate test packages, native execution behavior, version independence, and resolved 0/0 dynamic-access statistics. The exact Forge finalization command then passed all three test lanes, metadata and style checks, generated-test validation, and statistics generation without further publishable changes.
